title: Forgot your password?
intro: Enter the email you signed up with. If it matches an account, we send a link that lets you choose a new password.
emailHint: The same address you use to sign in.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.text_one: If {{email}} has an account, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It works once, for {{count}} minute.
sent.text_other: If {{email}} has an account, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It works once, for {{count}} minutes.
sent.bannerTitle: We answer the same way whether or not the address has an account.
sent.bannerText: That stops anyone using this form to find out who is registered on MarketLink.
sent.help: Nothing after a minute? Look in spam, or send it again. Sending again replaces the earlier link.

toast.sent: If that email is registered, you will receive a password reset link.
toast.failed: Could not send the reset link. Please try again.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
